notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33981899/3d51a4f5b00c6d924d560707979581eac36bba69.jpg[/img]

Hentai Mika is a hot puzzle game that fuses erotic flair with Japanese elegance. The main star, Mika, is a teasing samurai babe who's ready to strip — but only for the smartest players.
Every image is a new pose, a fresh vibe, and even more bare skin. Solve puzzles piece by piece and feast your eyes on this fierce beauty's body.

What’s waiting for you in the game:

🔓 30 erotic levels — each one peels more layers off Mika
🏆 30 achievements — track your naughty progress with pride
🖼️ Gallery — save all unlocked images and admire Mika whenever you want

🎮 3 difficulty modes — from cheeky fun to a real brain teaser:
[list]
[*] Easy — for chill players
[*] Medium — for those who like balance
[*] Hard — for the real conquerors
[/list]

Collect, unlock, enjoy — Hentai Mika is more than just a game. It’s a seductive journey into the body and soul of a samurai beauty, and only wit and patience will reveal it all.

notes.title: Next Gen Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471496/a65b2901990be268c77dc97582419b077f2dd834.jpg[/img]

🌍 New Update is Here! 🌍
We’ve been hard at work — and now it’s time to show you what’s new in the latest version of the game! 🎉

✨ What’s new:

🔧 Game engine updated — smoother, faster, better!

🐞 Major bugs fixed for a more stable experience

🚀 Performance improvements across all devices

🎮 New in-game features added to spice up your gameplay

Main menu redesigned — slicker and more intuitive

⚙️ Settings improved — now more customizable than ever

🌐 And most importantly… we’ve added support for even more languages!
🇫🇷 French, 🇩🇪 German, 🇮🇹 Italian, 🇪🇸 Spanish (Spain), 🇵🇹 Portuguese (Portugal), 🇧🇷 Portuguese (Brazil), 🇳🇱 Dutch, 🇨🇿 Czech, 🇷🇴 Romanian, 🇧🇬 Bulgarian, 🇸🇪 Swedish, 🇫🇮 Finnish, 🇳🇴 Norwegian, 🇩🇰 Danish, 🇮🇩 Indonesian, 🇮🇱 Hebrew, 🇮🇳 Hindi, 🇬🇷 Greek, 🇻🇳 Vietnamese, 🇹🇭 Thai, 🇪🇸 Spanish (Latin America) and more!

📢 This makes the game fully multilingual — players from all over the world can now enjoy it in their native language!

Thank you for your support — your feedback is what keeps us going! 💖
Let us know what you think of this update! 🙌
